item.title: North Bay health unit set to discontinue routine beach water monitoring this summer
item.description: The North Bay Parry Sound District Health Unit will be discontinuing monitoring water at public beaches this summer. item.title: Callander taxpayers can expect to see a 4.88 per cent increase
item.description: Callander tax bills are increasing 4.88 per cent this year. The financial impact for a family living in a $266,000 valued home will mean an increase of $15.07 per month or $180.88 a year. Council unanimously agreed and defended the increase during the March 10 council meeting. Council will vote on the operating and capital […]
